import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int P;
    static int[] fac, ifac, inv;

    static long fpow(long a, int b) {
        long c = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) c = c * a % P;
            a = a * a % P;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return c;
    }

    static void init(int n) {
        fac = new int[n + 1];
        ifac = new int[n + 1];
        inv = new int[n + 1];
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % P);
        ifac[n] = (int)fpow(fac[n], P - 2);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) ifac[i] = (int)((long)ifac[i + 1] * (i + 1) % P);
        inv[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) inv[i] = (int)((long)(P - P / i) * inv[P % i] % P);
    }

    static void add(int[] arr, int idx, int val) {
        arr[idx] += val;
        if (arr[idx] >= P) arr[idx] -= P;
    }

    static void sub(int[] arr, int idx, int val) {
        arr[idx] -= val;
        if (arr[idx] < 0) arr[idx] += P;
    }

    static int sub(int x) {
        if (x < 0) x += P;
        return x;
    }

    static void FMT(int[] f, int n) {
        for (int l = 1; l < n; l <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += l << 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < l; ++j) {
                    add(f, i + j + l, f[i + j]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void IFMT(int[] f, int n) {
        for (int l = 1; l < n; l <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += l << 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < l; ++j) {
                    sub(f, i + j + l, f[i + j]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void fpow(int[] f, int n, int k) {
        int[] t = new int[n + 1];
        int[] g = new int[n + 1];
        System.arraycopy(f, 0, t, 0, n + 1);
        f[0] = sub(1 - f[0]);
        g[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
            f[i] = 0;
            g[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
                f[i] = (int)((f[i] + (long)f[i - j] * g[j]) % P);
                g[i] = (int)((g[i] + (long)t[i - j] * g[j]) % P);
            }
            f[i] = sub(f[i] - g[i]);
            f[i] = (int)((t[i] + (long)f[i] * inv[i] % P) * k % P);
            g[i] = (int)((t[i] - (long)g[i] * inv[i] % P) * i % P);
            if (g[i] < 0) g[i] += P;
        }
    }

    static int geti() throws IOException {
        int x = 0, c;
        boolean neg = false;
        while ((c = System.in.read()) != -1 && (c < '0' || c > '9') && c != '-');
        if (c == '-') {
            neg = true;
            c = System.in.read();
        }
        do {
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = System.in.read();
        } while (c >= '0' && c <= '9');
        return neg ? -x : x;
    }

    static void pi(int k) {
        if (k < 0) {
            System.out.print('-');
            k = -k;
        }
        if (k >= 10) pi(k / 10);
        System.out.print((char) (k % 10 + '0'));
    }

    static void pi(int k, char ch) {
        pi(k);
        if (ch != 0) System.out.print(ch);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        int n = geti(), k = geti();
        P = geti();

        int ans = (int) fpow(k, n);
        if ((n & 1) == 0) {
            int m = (int) (Math.log(n) / Math.log(2)) + 1;
            int size = 1 << m;
            init(size);

            int[][] f = new int[m + 1][size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
                f[Integer.bitCount(i)][i] = ifac[i];
            }

            for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) {
                FMT(f[i], size);
            }

            int[] F = new int[m + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                    F[j] = f[j][i];
                }
                fpow(F, m + 1, k);
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                    f[j][i] = F[j];
                }
            }

            IFMT(f[Integer.bitCount(n)], size);
            ans = (int)((P + ans - (long)f[Integer.bitCount(n)][n] * fac[n] % P) % P);
        }
        pi(ans);
    }
}
